# ankra_ai_review_binding (Resource)

The AI Gateway settings of one source-control binding (a GitHub App installation, a GitLab or Bitbucket connection): AI review, @mention replies, pull request previews, merge when green and the review defaults its repositories inherit. Per-repository rules are `ankra_ai_review_repository`. Changes need organisation admin.

The binding itself is created by connecting the source-control provider; this resource only manages its settings. `ai_review` and `mention_replies` are always written; every other setting is managed only when set, and an unset one keeps the organisation's value and is read back as computed. Destroy stops managing the settings and leaves them as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ai_review_binding" "github" {
  scm_provider        = "github"
  binding_external_id = "12345678"
  ai_review           = true
  mention_replies     = true
  merge_when_green    = true
  max_reviews_per_pr  = 5
  custom_instructions = "Prefer small, focused diffs."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ai_review` (Boolean) Run the AI review on pull requests of the binding's repositories.
- `binding_external_id` (String) The binding's external id: the GitHub App installation id, or the GitLab or Bitbucket connection's id.
- `mention_replies` (Boolean) Answer @mentions on the binding's repositories.
- `scm_provider` (String) Source-control provider of the binding: `github`, `gitlab` or `bitbucket`.

### Optional

- `custom_instructions` (String) Extra instructions for the reviewer, at most 4000 characters. An empty string clears them.
- `max_reviews_per_pr` (Number) Cap on automatic reviews per pull request; `0` is no cap.
- `merge_when_green` (Boolean) Merge a pull request once its checks pass. It takes effect only while the binding is in Agent mode.
- `pr_previews` (Boolean) Build pull request previews.
- `review_drafts` (Boolean) Review draft pull requests automatically too.
- `review_model` (String) Model reviews run on: a model catalogue key, or an OpenRouter model id (`vendor/model`). An empty string inherits the platform default.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Display name of the binding.
- `id` (String) `<scm_provider>/<binding_external_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <scm_provider>/<binding_external_id>.
terraform import ankra_ai_review_binding.github github/12345678
```
